scope: Expanded development package only (240 runs; generations <550). Final-test feature files, predictions, metrics, and model artifacts were not read or modified.

protocol.cv: 5-fold stratified OOF on one manifest row per run; all Packet/Flow observations from each run are assigned together.
protocol.run_summaries: Mean or mean+population-standard-deviation of each feature computed within each run and separately inside each CV fold.
protocol.model_artifacts: No model files are saved or replaced; CV candidate estimators exist only in memory.
protocol.selection: No winning candidate is promoted automatically. Compare to the frozen baseline and require a new independent holdout for any changed production claim.

attacker_host_holdout_stress.design: Leave-one-attacker-host-out stress test; report only folds with all four classes in both train and test. Not used for model selection.

metadata_only_diagnostic.scope: Metadata-only diagnostic. These context fields are not classifier inputs; predictability is not proof of model bias.

decision_note: Normal class weighting and thresholds did not improve the prior nested outer-fold argmax baseline. This pipeline adds run-summary candidates and condition-aware stress tests for both Packet and Flow; results are development diagnostics, not evidence of a final-test accuracy increase.
